Rule 67:10:09:05 Individual's rights at hearing. CHAPTER 67:10:07

          67:10:09:05.  Individual's rights at hearing. During a disqualification hearing the individual or the individual's representative may take the following actions:

          (1)  Before the date of the hearing and during the hearing, examine the contents of the individual's case file and all documents and records to be used by the department at the hearing;

          (2)  Present the case personally or with the aid of an authorized representative;

          (3)  Bring witnesses;

          (4)  Establish pertinent facts and circumstances;

          (5)  Advance any arguments without undue influence; and

          (6)  Question or refute any testimony or evidence, including the opportunity to confront and cross-examine adverse witnesses.

          Source: 24 SDR 24, effective August 31, 1997.

          General Authority: SDCL 28-7A-3(5).

          Law Implemented: SDCL 28-7A-3(5), 28-7A-16.
